rules.description: Marriage or civil partnership must be registered in England or Wales
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for marriages and civil partnerships registered in England and Wales only

rules.description: Marriage must be registered after July 1837 (start of civil registration)
rules.reason_if_failed: Civil registration began in July 1837. Earlier marriages are not in the GRO register

rules.description: Applicant must provide either a GRO index reference number OR full marriage details
rules.reason_if_failed: You need either the GRO index reference number or the full details (names, date, location) of the marriage

rules.description: Valid delivery address must be provided for certificate dispatch
rules.reason_if_failed: A delivery address is required to post the certificate

rules.description: Valid payment method required (debit or credit card)
rules.reason_if_failed: Payment by debit or credit card is required. Certificates cost £12.50 (standard) or £38.50 (priority)

explanation_template: Marriage certificate eligibility: {outcome}. Certificate cost: {price}. Dispatch: {dispatch_time}

edge_cases.description: Marriage or civil partnership registered abroad with FCDO Overseas Registration Unit
edge_cases.action: Hand off to FCDO Overseas Registration Unit. Email overseas.registrationunit@fcdo.gov.uk. Cost typically £50 plus courier fees. Not available from GRO until November of following year.

edge_cases.description: Marriage registered very recently (less than 5 working days ago)
edge_cases.action: Advise that recent registrations may not yet be in the GRO system. Recommend waiting a few more days or contacting the local register office where the marriage took place.

edge_cases.description: Applicant believes there is an error in the registered details
edge_cases.action: Hand off to GRO corrections service. Contact GRO on 0300 123 1837. Corrections must be made before ordering certificate.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is not one of the parties to the marriage/civil partnership
edge_cases.action: Proceed with order. Anyone can order a marriage or civil partnership certificate for family tree research. No special authorization needed for marriages (unlike birth certificates).
